howto.what: 给项目加上 Cisco Webex 频道支持:从 channels 分支复制 Webex 适配器、注册到频道入口、安装指定版本的适配器依赖包,然后构建并跑注册测试,再提示你填写机器人凭据。
howto.when: 当你要求给项目添加 Webex 频道集成,或在 /setup 流程中补 Webex 支持时接管,按步骤复制适配器、注册、装依赖并测试。

howto.what_en: Adds Cisco Webex support to your project: it copies the Webex adapter from the channels branch, registers it in the channel barrel, installs the pinned adapter package, then builds and runs the registration test and prompts for bot credentials.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add Webex channel integration to the project, or mid-setup when Webex support is needed; it then copies, registers, installs and tests the adapter.
